note: Supplementary methodological experiments. All baseline results are unchanged.

E3_discontinuity.design: Apparent finite-difference gradients are recomputed from the frozen 12-step bisection brackets and the 12x12 oxygen-transfer response surface; gradient-based optimisers are then run offline on that recorded surface.

offline_optimisation.objective: minimise squared end-of-batch yield error by varying alpha_kLa on the recorded median response curve (linear interpolation)

E3_discontinuity.interpretation: Where the response is a step of ~100 pp, the centred difference does not converge: its apparent gradient grows as 1/h, and gradient optimisers terminate at their starting points.

protocol: 1. Enumerate the state (or parameter) subset claimed as deliverable and the measurement channels actually used by the estimator.
2. Assemble the observation operator H with one row per channel per sampling time; a one-hot row marks a directly observed state, a sum row marks an aggregate assay.
3. Column-normalise H, compute its singular values, rank, nullity and condition number.
4. If nullity > 0, simulate adding one independent row per null-space direction and recompute the rank; only new measurement types can reduce nullity.
5. Reject the delivery claim for every null-space direction regardless of fit quality; record the claim as conditional on H, not on the process.
6. Report the rank table alongside the numerical fit so that a reviewer can distinguish a lack of data volume from a lack of observability.
E4_identifiability.interpretation: Nullity 4 is a property of the available measurement types; 50 additional rows of the existing aggregate assay leave rank 1 unchanged, whereas four independent compartment-resolved rows restore rank 4.

E2_leave_batch_out.design: Five disjoint folds over the 86-batch roster. Twenty held-out batches (four per fold, spread across the recorded-yield range) receive a median prior, and eight representative held-out batches receive three drawn priors each. Priors are built only from the calibration vectors of the other folds; the batch's own inputs are used, but its recorded product mass enters only the final error calculation. The subset is declared explicitly.

prior_strategies.median_prior: per-parameter median over the training folds
prior_strategies.drawn_prior: a complete parameter vector drawn from the training folds

E2_leave_batch_out.interpretation: Reconstruction consistency (2.3448% with per-batch calibration) and conditional transferability (held-out parameter priors) are different quantities and must not be interchanged.

E6_uncertainty_propagation.design: Six Monte Carlo replicates on five representative batches. Nominal batch-level random effects (mux 0.41 +/- 0.025, mup 0.041 +/- 0.0025, alpha_kLa 85 +/- 10) are applied as multiplicative perturbations to each batch's own calibrated vector; no recorded yield is used as input.
E6_uncertainty_propagation.interpretation: Parameter uncertainty propagating through the same frozen engine is compared with the 2.3448% per-batch reconstruction error.
